title: Black Friday Cyber Threats — Part Two: Retailers
content_md: In Part One of our Black Friday Cyber Threats blog series, we examined how Black Friday creates opportunities for attackers to target consumers through fraud, impersonation, credential theft, and malware. Retailers experience many of those same threats at scale, while also contending with bot activity, business-logic abuse, operational disruption, and growing questions around AI-driven commerce. … Black Friday Cyber Threats — Part Two: Retailers Article Link: Black Friday Cyber Threats — Part Two: Retailers | Arctic Wolf
